card.name: First word after WARNINGS heading
card.fires_on: The first word or word piece right after a WARNINGS section heading in a drug label, such as Avoid, Safe, Fatal or Application. Also weakly on a few words in a software description.

modes.label: Opening word of warnings

modes.label: Start of a warning topic
modes.description: The first piece of a topic name, such as an enzyme, right after WARNINGS.

modes.description: Scattered words in a sentence about code wrappers, a weaker side pattern.
